canonical_example.translation: The activists freed the caged animals.

canonical_example.text: Rescatamos un terreno para poder hacer un parque para niños.
canonical_example.translation: We reclaimed a plot of land so we can make a park for children.

canonical_example.text: Al final logré rescatar la carpeta perdida.
canonical_example.translation: I was able to get the lost folder back in the end.
